sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 9 August 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000174-P1 was put before Desert Bloom Family Clinic 174 on behalf of PFIZER.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 3 rebate of 5 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Pneumococcal minimum take of 260 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer turned the terms down.
